category_title: Minimally verbal young children with severe ASD and language processing deficits
scenario_title: Turn-taking and joint attention in play activities
minimal_context: MG and the tutor are sitting together at the early intervention centre to practice taking turns putting puzzle pieces on a board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's play with the puzzle pieces. Whose turn?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (MG picks up a puzzle piece, but her play behavior is primarily exploratory, lacking symbolic and pretend play.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Put the piece on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (MG does not put the piece on the board and shows a lack of abilities to sustain eye contact with the tutor.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, it is my turn now. Give me the puzzle piece.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (MG does not respond or hand over the piece, demonstrating a lack of abilities to participate in joint attention and to take turns in the back-and-forth interaction.)

task.content: participate in activities with back-and-forth interactions

context.materials: rolling ball, puzzle pieces, board, objects, box

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to participate in activities with back-and-forth interactions
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: lack of abilities to sustain eye contact, to participate in joint attention and to take turns
